name: submit_slurm_job
description: Submit a job to the Slurm HPC cluster head node via SSH. Records the job in DynamoDB and returns task_id and slurm_job_id. Runs in MOCK_MODE by default until pcluster infra is wired.

thread_id.description: Thread ID for this conversation (= AgentCore session_id). PK of the DynamoDB thread row.

script_path.description: Absolute path of the sbatch script on the head node (e.g. /home/ec2-user/jobs/train.sh)

workflow_step.description: Workflow step label for multi-step pipelines (e.g. ingest, compute, validate)

_user_id.description: Authenticated user id — always pass the value of the CURRENT_USER_ID env var. Stored on the DynamoDB row for attribution.

name: check_slurm_job_status
description: Poll Slurm for a job's current state via sacct and update DynamoDB. Returns the canonical status and whether it has reached a terminal state.

name: cancel_slurm_job
description: Cancel a running Slurm job via scancel and mark its DynamoDB row CANCELLED.

name: list_slurm_jobs
description: List Slurm jobs submitted during a session, with their current status.

thread_id.description: Thread ID for this conversation (= AgentCore session_id). PK of the DynamoDB thread row.
